text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: p1 - APAC region error spike on /generate (latency 500ms -> 3s, 15% 5xx) — paging maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): saw it, joining. any customer reports? :eyes:

kevin (support): 3 tickets opened from two enterprise customers in APAC, intermittent failures starting 12:04 UTC. linking logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/tx12345 (redacted)

maria (oncall): thanks. quick blast — is this during the regional blue->green shift? last deploy at 11:58 UTC.

raj (infra): yes, we rolled APAC green at 11:58 and started weighted traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100%. DNS weights were updated but we saw uneven egress at the edge. Some ASNs still hitting older edge path.

olivia (prod): green build included new tokenizer prepatch and a feature-flag gating a KV-cache change (flag: new-kv-routing). hypothesis: green + flag = cache miss storm causing CPU spikes and increased latency.

maria (oncall): can we confirm error mode? 5xx are mainly 502/504 from model proxy or timeouts?

raj (infra): 80% 504 from model-proxy, increased queue depth on green pool GPUs. k8s pod restarts up 12% on green ASG.

emily (sre): checking metrics + traces. heatmap shows green hosts with KV cache misses x5 baseline. Client request latencies climb after ~800 tokens. Looks like cache routing mismatch.

maria (oncall): OK. mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag to disable new-kv-routing on green 2) pause weight ramp and shift traffic back to blue 3) kill green instances entirely. Which is fastest and safest?

olivia (prod): flip flag first — minimal change and should restore cache behavior. Doing flag toggle now: /flags set new-kv-routing=false --scope=apac-green

incident-bot: Command executed by olivia (prod) at 12:13 UTC: /flags set new-kv-routing=false --scope=apac-green

raj (infra): flag propagated to control plane, but DNS TTLs mean some clients still hit green for ~30s. we can accelerate by temporarily routing 0% weight to green at edge LB. toggling now.

maria (oncall): please do that, raj.

raj (infra): updated LB weights: apac-green -> 0%, apac-blue -> 100%. deployment control plane shows weights converged in ~20s.

emily (sre): metrics: 5xx rate dropping, p50 latency returning toward baseline. 12:17 UTC -> 12:22 UTC saw steady improvement.

kevin (support): relaying to customers, acknowledged. one customer asked for ETA — gave them 30m and root-cause note.

maria (oncall): good. root-cause summary so far: green variant introduced a KV routing change behind a feature flag; during weighted rollout some edge paths routed to green with cache topology mismatch -> cache miss storms -> model-proxy timeouts for long requests. Partial DNS/edge propagation exacerbated the exposure.

olivia (prod): immediate follow-ups: revert flag permanently on green, ship a hotfix to make KV-router backward compatible, add e2e canary that exercises long-token paths.

emily (sre): operations follow-ups: tighten blue/green ramping guardrails (smaller weight steps + longer probes), add automatic early kill if 5xx spikes > 3% within 5m, and add a DNS-convergence check for region rollouts.

maria (oncall): on-call handoff: I'm wrapping initial mitigation and will create a short incident ticket. emily, can you take ownership for follow-ups? I'll hand to you at shift change in 2 hours.

emily (sre): taking post-incident action items. will sync with raj + olivia and post RCA draft in #postmortems tomorrow.

maria (oncall): customer impact note for incident: APAC region ~6% of overall traffic, but error spike affected ~12% of requests for 18 minutes (12:04–12:22 UTC). two enterprise customers reported errors; no data loss. filing incident severity = P1-brief.

kevin (support): I updated customer tickets with workaround and expected RCA link when available.

olivia (prod): reminders: feature flag gating must have roll-forward + rollback playbook and a canary test that includes cold-cache scenarios.

maria (oncall): closing pager for now — monitoring for 30m. thanks all :heart: 

incident-bot: Incident closed by maria (oncall) at 12:31 UTC — pager resolved.

emily (sre): adding timeline + metrics snippets to incident doc: 
```
- 11:58 UTC: APAC green roll start (weights 0->10)
- 12:04 UTC: 5xx spike detected -> pager fired
- 12:13 UTC: flag new-kv-routing disabled on green
- 12:14 UTC: LB weights moved green->0
- 12:22 UTC: error rates back to baseline
- 12:31 UTC: pager closed
```

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll create incident ticket 2026-APAC-001 and link this thread.

kevin (support): +1, please include customer ticket numbers.

olivia (prod): will follow up on the KV-router fix patch.
